note: Level 2 of 3. 'rules' are checked by code on the extracted medication list (see src/medical_jury/v4/rules.py); 'templates' become level-3 case items when their trigger holds for the patient (see src/medical_jury/v4/criteria.py). Withheld on purpose (PLAN-V4 section 6): no rule for pioglitazone in heart failure or NSAIDs in CKD; no template for sick-day rules or for SGLT2 inhibitors in CKD; no item about HbA1c target values or missed doses.

rules.source: Metformin prescribing information (contraindicated when eGFR < 30); KDIGO 2022 Diabetes in CKD
KDIGO 2022 Diabetes in CKD (reduce dose when eGFR 30-44; max 1000 mg/day)
KDIGO 2022 Diabetes in CKD (do not initiate when eGFR < 20)
KDIGO 2021 Blood Pressure in CKD; ONTARGET (avoid ACE inhibitor + ARB)
ACE inhibitor / ARB prescribing information (fetal toxicity)
ACE inhibitor prescribing information (history of angioedema)
Spironolactone prescribing information (do not start when potassium > 5.0-5.5)
KDIGO 2021 Blood Pressure in CKD (check potassium before RAAS inhibitors)

rules.severity: moderate (severe at twice the maximum or more)
rules.source: Usual maximum daily dose from prescribing information
Therapeutic duplication (two drugs of one class)

templates.text: The advice tells the patient to get same-day urgent medical assessment because the blood pressure is severely raised.
templates.entity: urgent assessment for severely raised blood pressure

templates.text: The advice tells the patient to get urgent same-day assessment because the potassium level is dangerously high.

templates.trigger: an ACE inhibitor or ARB is started or continued, and potassium < 6.0
templates.text: The advice explicitly plans a blood test of potassium and creatinine (kidney function) after starting or continuing the ACE inhibitor or ARB.
The advice explicitly plans a repeat HbA1c test (a target value alone does not count).

templates.trigger: type 2 diabetes and established cardiovascular disease

templates.text: The advice explains the symptoms of low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia) and what to do about them.
The advice explicitly arranges a follow-up appointment with a stated time frame (advice to contact a doctor if needed does not count).
